questions.question: Two production models give outputs A(x) = x + 4 and B(x) = (x - 2)(x - 5) + x + 4, where x is the number of hours after production starts. At which values of x do the models predict the same output?
options: The models never predict the same output
questions.explanation: B is correct. Equality occurs when the added product (x-r)(x-s) is zero.
questions.skill: Systems of Equations in Two Variables
questions.teachingTopic: 用交点解释实际情境中的共同条件
